quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'Insofar as' qualifies how firm a conclusion the evidence allows.
quests.explanation: Insofar as the evidence permits any firm conclusion (qualifying phrase) + it leans decisively toward the alternative hypothesis (main clause). 'Weight of evidence' is a formal phrase for cumulative support across a body of data.
quests.textToSpeak: Insofar as the evidence permits any firm conclusion, it leans decisively toward the alternative hypothesis.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal inverted conditional 'Were... to' replacing 'If it were to'.
quests.explanation: Were the field to embrace this finding fully (formal inverted conditional) + the existing theoretical framework would need substantial revision (hypothetical result). 'Theoretical framework' refers to the interconnected system of concepts within a discipline.
quests.textToSpeak: Were the field to embrace this finding fully, the existing theoretical framework would need substantial revision.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal subordinate phrase 'Notwithstanding' contrasts sophistication with a key limitation.
quests.explanation: Notwithstanding the study's methodological sophistication (formal contrast phrase) + its conclusions rest on a sample too narrow to generalize (main clause). Sophisticated methods cannot fully compensate for an inadequate sample size.
quests.textToSpeak: Notwithstanding the study's methodological sophistication, its conclusions rest on a sample too narrow to generalize.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Fronted phrase 'Far from refuting' sets up an ironic reversal.
quests.explanation: Far from refuting the original theory (fronted contrast phrase) + this critique merely identifies a boundary it never claimed to cross (main clause). A 'boundary condition' marks the limits within which a theory applies.
quests.textToSpeak: Far from refuting the original theory, this critique merely identifies a boundary it never claimed to cross.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Much as' introduces strong concession against empirical disconnect.
quests.explanation: Much as one admires the system's internal coherence (strong concession) + its detachment from observable phenomena remains deeply troubling (main clause). Internal coherence alone does not guarantee a theory's connection to reality.
quests.textToSpeak: Much as one admires the system's internal coherence, its detachment from observable phenomena remains deeply troubling.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Provided' introduces a condition involving simplifying assumptions.
quests.explanation: Provided one accepts certain idealizing assumptions (condition) + the model yields predictions of impressive and unexpected precision (result). Idealizing assumptions simplify reality to make formal modeling tractable.
quests.textToSpeak: Provided one accepts certain idealizing assumptions, the model yields predictions of impressive and unexpected precision.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Whatever' introduces unconditional concession before a pragmatic claim.
quests.explanation: Whatever reservations remain about its theoretical commitments (unconditional concession) + the framework's practical utility is difficult to dispute (main clause). This separates theoretical doubts from a separate question of practical effectiveness.
quests.textToSpeak: Whatever reservations remain about its theoretical commitments, the framework's practical utility is difficult to dispute.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Fronted phrase 'Short of' introduces an extensive, costly research requirement.
quests.explanation: Short of a multi-decade study spanning several populations (extensive requirement) + researchers cannot resolve this causal question definitively (main clause). Establishing robust causation often requires extraordinarily extensive research designs.
quests.textToSpeak: Short of a multi-decade study spanning several populations, researchers cannot resolve this causal question definitively.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted concessive clause 'parsimonious though it is'.
quests.explanation: Subject (The model) + parsimonious though it is (inverted concessive clause) + struggles when confronted with messy real-world data (main verb). 'Parsimonious' means achieving explanatory power with minimal assumptions.
quests.textToSpeak: The model, parsimonious though it is, struggles when confronted with messy real-world data.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'In as much as' qualifies an unusually strong unifying achievement.
quests.explanation: In as much as any paradigm can unify a fragmented field (qualifying phrase) + this one comes remarkably close (main clause). Unifying fragmented subfields is among the rarest achievements in any discipline.
quests.textToSpeak: In as much as any paradigm can unify a fragmented field, this one comes remarkably close.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted third conditional reflecting on a discipline's methodological history.
quests.explanation: Had the discipline adopted rigorous falsifiability standards decades earlier (inverted third conditional) + this theoretical proliferation might have been constrained (hypothetical result). 'Falsifiability' is the criterion that a scientific claim must be testable.
quests.textToSpeak: Had the discipline adopted rigorous falsifiability standards decades earlier, this theoretical proliferation might have been constrained.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'To the extent that' qualifies an epistemological substitution.
quests.explanation: To the extent that agreement can substitute for verification (qualifying phrase) + this work has achieved remarkable scholarly convergence (main clause). 'Intersubjective agreement' means shared agreement among multiple independent observers.
quests.textToSpeak: To the extent that agreement can substitute for verification, this work has achieved remarkable scholarly convergence.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted concessive 'sophisticated though it is' embedded mid-sentence.
quests.explanation: Subject (The critique) + sophisticated though it is (inverted concessive phrase) + fails to engage the strongest version of the opposing position (main verb). Engaging only weaker versions of an opposing view is a recognized weakness.
quests.textToSpeak: The critique, sophisticated though it is, fails to engage the strongest version of the opposing position.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal inverted conditional with sweeping disciplinary stakes.
quests.explanation: Were the discipline to abandon its current orthodoxy (formal inverted conditional) + accumulated knowledge would need comprehensive reconstruction (hypothetical result). 'Methodological orthodoxy' refers to the dominant accepted research approach within a field.
quests.textToSpeak: Were the discipline to abandon its current orthodoxy, accumulated knowledge would need comprehensive reconstruction.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal subordinate phrase 'Notwithstanding' contrasts empirical success with conceptual difficulty.
quests.explanation: Notwithstanding its predictive success across many domains (formal contrast phrase) + the theory generates persistent and unresolved conceptual puzzles (main clause). Predictive success and conceptual clarity are distinct theoretical virtues.
quests.textToSpeak: Notwithstanding its predictive success across many domains, the theory generates persistent and unresolved conceptual puzzles.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Fronted phrase 'Far from resolving' creates emphasis through reversal.
quests.explanation: Far from resolving the tension between two frameworks (fronted contrast phrase) + this synthesis introduces a new layer of complexity (main clause). Attempts at synthesis sometimes generate new rather than resolve old difficulties.
quests.textToSpeak: Far from resolving the tension between two frameworks, this synthesis introduces a new layer of complexity.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Much as' introduces concession before noting a limitation.
quests.explanation: Much as the innovation deserves recognition for originality (concession) + its practical applicability remains almost entirely untested (critique). Theoretical originality and practical applicability are independent dimensions of scholarly value.
quests.textToSpeak: Much as the innovation deserves recognition for originality, its practical applicability remains almost entirely untested.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Provided' with an embedded note about contested terms.
quests.explanation: Provided one accepts the field's contested operational definitions (condition) + the resulting comparative data is genuinely impressive (main clause). 'Operational definitions' specify precisely how abstract concepts are measured in research.
quests.textToSpeak: Provided one accepts the field's contested operational definitions, the resulting comparative data is genuinely impressive.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Whatever' introduces unconditional concession before a lasting legacy.
quests.explanation: Whatever the eventual fate of this framework (unconditional concession) + its methodological innovations have already transformed the field's approach (main clause). Methodological contributions sometimes outlive the specific theories that introduced them.
quests.textToSpeak: Whatever the eventual fate of this framework, its methodological innovations have already transformed the field's approach.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Fronted phrase 'Short of' introduces an unforeseeable, transformative exception.
quests.explanation: Short of an unforeseeable breakthrough in measurement (transformative exception) + this theoretical dispute appears destined to remain unresolved (main clause). Some scientific disputes await technological advances that cannot currently be predicted.
quests.textToSpeak: Short of an unforeseeable breakthrough in measurement, this theoretical dispute appears destined to remain unresolved.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted concessive clause 'internally consistent though it proves'.
quests.explanation: Subject (The argument) + internally consistent though it proves (inverted concessive clause) + rests on premises few outside the tradition would accept (main verb). Internal consistency does not guarantee widely shared starting premises.
quests.textToSpeak: The argument, internally consistent though it proves, rests on premises few outside the tradition would accept.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'In as much as' qualifies a historiographical achievement.
quests.explanation: In as much as any interpretation can transcend its era's biases (qualifying phrase) + this account comes unusually close (main clause). All historical interpretation is inevitably shaped to some degree by its own time.
quests.textToSpeak: In as much as any interpretation can transcend its era's biases, this account comes unusually close.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted third conditional reflecting on imprecise classification.
quests.explanation: Had the original taxonomy been built with greater precision (inverted third conditional) + decades of definitional dispute might have been avoided (hypothetical result). Imprecise foundational schemes can generate decades of unproductive disagreement.
quests.textToSpeak: Had the original taxonomy been built with greater precision, decades of definitional dispute might have been avoided.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'To the extent that' qualifies a framework's resilience to anomalies.
quests.explanation: To the extent that a framework can accommodate anomalies without ad hoc fixes (qualifying phrase) + this one shows real resilience (main clause). 'Ad hoc' modifications adjust a theory solely to rescue it from contradicting evidence.
quests.textToSpeak: To the extent that a framework can accommodate anomalies without ad hoc fixes, this one shows real resilience.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Reduced clause 'defensible in the abstract' modifies the position.
quests.explanation: Subject (The position) + defensible in the abstract (reduced clause) + encounters serious difficulties once applied to concrete cases (main verb). Abstract defensibility frequently confronts unexpected complications in concrete application.
quests.textToSpeak: The position, defensible in the abstract, encounters serious difficulties once applied to concrete cases.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal inverted conditional describing a methodological failure.
quests.explanation: Were researchers to disregard this category of confounding variables (formal inverted conditional) + the resulting conclusions would be unreliable (hypothetical result). 'Confounding variables' are unaccounted-for factors that can distort research results.
quests.textToSpeak: Were researchers to disregard this category of confounding variables, the resulting conclusions would be unreliable.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal subordinate phrase 'Notwithstanding' contrasts elegance with empirical cost.
quests.explanation: Notwithstanding the elegance the unified framework achieves (formal contrast phrase) + its cost in empirical specificity remains a real concern (main clause). Theoretical unification often comes at the cost of detailed empirical precision.
quests.textToSpeak: Notwithstanding the elegance the unified framework achieves, its cost in empirical specificity remains a real concern.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Fronted phrase 'Far from being' dismisses a dismissive characterization.
quests.explanation: Far from being a terminological dispute (fronted contrast phrase) + this disagreement reflects genuinely incompatible underlying conceptions (main clause). Apparent terminological disputes sometimes mask deeper, substantive theoretical disagreements.
quests.textToSpeak: Far from being a terminological dispute, this disagreement reflects genuinely incompatible underlying conceptions.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Much as' introduces concession before noting growing dissent.
quests.explanation: Much as the consensus view dominates mainstream discourse (concession) + a vocal minority has raised serious objections (contrasting development). Scholarly consensus can coexist with organized minority dissent.
quests.textToSpeak: Much as the consensus view dominates mainstream discourse, a vocal minority has raised serious objections.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'Insofar as' qualifies an unusually strong claim of decisiveness.
quests.explanation: Insofar as a single study can ever be decisive (qualifying phrase) + this comprehensive investigation comes unusually close (main clause). Genuine decisiveness from a single study is exceptionally rare in empirical research.
quests.textToSpeak: Insofar as a single study can ever be decisive, this comprehensive investigation comes unusually close.
